fields.mechanism: Dynamic thermal modelling to predict PV module performance and consider the effect of heat capacity on module temperature.
fields.intervention: Implement a dynamic thermal model in the solar panel design to account for hourly meteorological data, including wind speed and direction, and module parameters, and use the calculated heat capacity value to optimize the panel's performance.
fields.expected_effect: Improved efficiency of the solar panel by reducing the impact of high temperatures on its performance.
fields.falsification_test: Conduct experiments to measure the solar panel's efficiency under varying temperature conditions, with and without the dynamic thermal model, to verify the expected effect.
fields.mechanism_source_span: "Thermal modelling is a method to predict the performance of a PV module using essentially the 1st law of thermodynamics and available data."
